facts.value: Goethe University promotes diversity, supports global networking, and establishes clear impulses for the future with its internationalization strategy.
Goethe Inbound: Study and research in Frankfurt. Discover the diverse offerings for international students and researchers at Goethe University and shape your personal academic path.

Goethe Outbound: With Goethe into the world: Whether semester abroad, ERASMUS study, internship, or activity in research and teaching – a stay abroad opens many new opportunities and perspectives for your personal and professional development.
Goethe University is internationally connected and maintains a variety of international university partnerships.
Scientific exchange begins where people come together to communicate.
Goethe Study Experience Program (GStEP) expands academic offerings starting Winter semester 2026/27, aimed at exchange students from international partner universities.
Goethe Research Experience Program (GREP) focuses on curiosity, collaboration, and international friendships.
New ways, new perspectives: Goethe University graduates participants from the contact studies program.
Goethe University maintains partnerships with over 450 universities in Europe and worldwide, promoting international exchange among students and international research.
